verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; cost per lead doubled and build milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 126 leads from Meta at an average cost of $5.92 per lead, but the most recent 7 days tell a harder story: leads fell 40% week-over-week while spend rose 31%, pushing cost per lead up 119%. The primary driver is that roughly 80% of your paid budget is concentrated in a single awareness-focused campaign that is generating clicks but converting fewer of those clicks into leads — a pattern consistent with creative or audience fatigue. Compounding this, nine of ten agreed build milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, and Google Search campaigns — remain undelivered, which means the paid spend is running without the infrastructure it was designed to work alongside. We are refreshing the ad creative and rebalancing budget away from the awareness campaign this week, and the overdue deliverables are being escalated as the immediate priority. You should expect cost per lead to stabilise as the creative rotates; meaningful improvement in lead volume depends on the build milestones landing.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead is accelerating in the wrong direction as the awareness campaign shows fatigue — leads averaged 4 per day over the last 3 days versus 9 per day the 3 days before that.
